facts.label: Said + passado
facts.sub: Para contar o que alguém disse, use said + sujeito + verbo no passado: She said she was tired. Com pessoa, use told: She told me she was fine.

facts.label: Contar o que alguém disse
facts.sub: Use said + sujeito + passado: She said she was tired. A frase original está no presente (I am tired), mas ao contar ela volta um passo. O that é opcional: She said that she was tired.

facts.label: Contar para alguém
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa: She told me she was fine. Não diga said me. Depois de told, sempre vem uma pessoa: told me, told us, told her.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “She said she was tired” reports what she said.
After said, we always keep the present: She said she is tired.
items.why: In reported speech we usually use the past.

items.s: Told needs a person after it: told me.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “She said she was tired” reports what she said. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
After said, we always keep the present: She said she is tired. → Falso (In reported speech we usually use the past.)
Told needs a person after it: told me. → Verdadeiro (Yes: told me, told her.)

paragraphs: It is a rainy Tuesday morning in a small kitchen in Seattle. Dawn puts a warm kettle on the stove. She expects her friend Jane to arrive soon. But only Eva comes through the door. Eva says Jane has a message for everyone. Dawn wants to know what Jane said.
“Eva, why is the kitchen so quiet this morning?” says Dawn. “Our friend Jane said she was tired, so she stayed in bed.” says Eva. “Really? She told me she was fine yesterday.” says Dawn.
